description: This file defines a provider class (TodoProvider) for managing the state of a Todo list in a Flutter application. It handles CRUD operations, filtering todos based on their completion status, and notifies listeners about state changes. It interacts with a TodoService for backend API calls and manages a list of Todo objects.

classes.name: TodoProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the following: a list of to-do items, the current filter (all, active, completed), loading state, and methods to fetch, add, update, and delete to-dos. It interacts with TodoService to perform backend operations and notifies listeners on state changes.

methods.name: updateToken
methods.description: Updates the token used by the TodoService instance.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of todos from the backend, applying the current filter, and updates the internal list. Manages the loading state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the current todo filter and refreshes the todo list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new todo item with the specified title and optional description, adds it to the list, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Updates a todo's completion status, updates it in the list, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Edits an existing todo's details and updates it in the list, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a todo by ID from the backend and removes it from the internal list, then notifies listeners.
